title: Human Resource Manager
description:
Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Human Resources Manager with 8 to 9 years of experience in managing end-to-end HR operations, talent acquisition, employee engagement, performance management, HR policies, and statutory compliance. The ideal candidate will have strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, along with the ability to align HR strategies with business objectives and foster a positive, productive workplace culture. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. HR Operations and Administration Manage day-to-day HR operations, including employee documentation, onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and exit formalities. Develop, implement, and maintain HR policies, procedures, and employee handbooks. Maintain accurate employee records, HR databases, and personnel files. Ensure smooth coordination of payroll inputs, attendance, leave management, and employee lifecycle processes. Identify opportunities to improve HR processes and operational efficiency. 
 2. Talent Acquisition and Workforce Planning Manage end-to-end recruitment for various departments and levels. Work closely with department heads to understand manpower requirements and workforce planning needs. Develop effective sourcing strategies through job portals, professional networks, employee referrals, and recruitment agencies. Monitor recruitment metrics, including time-to-hire, cost-per-hire, and offer-to-joining ratio. Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process. 

 3. Employee Engagement and Retention Develop and implement employee engagement, recognition, and retention initiatives. Conduct employee satisfaction surveys and recommend improvements based on feedback. Address employee grievances, workplace concerns, and interpersonal conflicts professionally. Promote a positive, inclusive, and performance-driven work culture. Conduct exit interviews and analyze attrition trends to develop retention strategies. 
 4. Performance Management and Employee Development Manage the annual performance appraisal and goal-setting process. Coordinate with managers on performance reviews, feedback, and performance improvement plans. Identify training and development needs across departments. Design and coordinate learning and development initiatives to enhance employee capabilities. Support career development, succession planning, and internal talent mobility. 
 5. Compensation, Benefits, and Payroll Coordination Coordinate with the payroll and finance teams to ensure accurate and timely salary processing. Review compensation structures, salary revisions, incentives, and employee benefits. Support salary benchmarking and compensation planning. Ensure proper management of employee benefits, reimbursements, and other HR-related payments. 

 6. Statutory Compliance and Employee Relations Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, employment regulations, and statutory requirements. Coordinate statutory filings, audits, inspections, and maintenance of relevant records. Oversee applicable requirements relating to PF, ESI, professional tax, gratuity, bonus, and other statutory benefits. Manage disciplinary procedures, employee grievances, workplace investigations, and conflict resolution. Ensure compliance with applicable POSH requirements and support awareness initiatives and related processes. Coordinate with legal advisors and external consultants on employment-related matters, where required. 

 7. HR Analytics and Reporting Prepare and present regular HR reports and dashboards to management. Monitor key HR metrics, including headcount, attrition, absenteeism, recruitment, and employee engagement. Use HR data to identify trends and recommend corrective actions. Support HR budgeting, manpower cost analysis, and annual HR planning. 


 8. Strategic HR and Leadership Partner with senior management and department heads on people-related business decisions. Align HR initiatives with organizational goals and business growth plans. Lead and mentor HR team members and allocate responsibilities effectively. Drive organizational development, change management, and culture-building initiatives. Promote continuous improvement through HR technology, automation, and process standardization. 

 Required Qualifications MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or a relevant postgraduate qualification. Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline. 89 years of progressive experience in Human Resources, preferably with experience handling independent HR operations and managing a team. Strong knowledge of HR processes, recruitment, employee relations, performance management, and labour law compliance.  Required Skills and Competencies Strong leadership and team management skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Effective problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Strong interpersonal skills and conflict resolution capabilities. Good understanding of employment practices and statutory compliance. Ability to handle confidential information with integrity. Strong analytical, organizational, and multitasking skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic business environment. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Recruitment turnaround time and quality of hiring. Employee retention and attrition rate. Employee engagement and satisfaction levels. Accuracy and timeliness of HR operations and payroll inputs. Statutory compliance and audit readiness. Completion of performance appraisals within defined timelines. Training effectiveness and employee development. HR process efficiency and employee query resolution time. 

 Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a proactive HR professional with a balance of operational expertise and strategic thinking. Job Summary 
 The future of HR Operations is being redefined at Baxter. Across the company, HR is unlocking new ways to deliver value - not just through processes, but through experiences that empower people and build confidence. This is a moment of transformation, and HR Operations is at the center of it. We are shaping a world-class HR Operations organization that blends scale, precision, and innovation. By harnessing technology and process excellence, we are creating solutions that strengthen compliance, accelerate change, and elevate the employee journey. Joining Baxter means stepping into a role where your expertise will directly support employees worldwide and help define what great looks like. 

 Your Role in the Transformation 
 As a Senior Analyst in HR Operations EDM, you will act as a subject matter expert for Pre-Payroll and HR data management with deep Workday expertise. You ll own data integrity, audits, and reporting while driving process standardization and automation. This role places you at the core of Baxter s transformation, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and innovation in HR operations that directly impact employee experience and organizational trust.

 Serve as SME for Pre-Payroll and HR Domain with advanced Workday expertise. Solve complex employee data cases and escalations with precision. Own Workday data integrity, audits, and reporting to ensure reliability. Guarantee accuracy and timeliness of employee data across systems. Generate periodic HR reports and dashboards for leadership visibility. Partner with Payroll and Finance to ensure accurate payroll processing. Drive HR process standardization, simplification, and automation initiatives. Support system enhancements, including UAT and change management. Maintain Knowledge Articles and SOPs to strengthen operational clarity. Train and mentor junior team members on HR transactions. 

 What You ll Bring 
 Several years of experience in HR Operations, Shared Services, or GBS. Strong understanding of HR processes (employee lifecycle, payroll inputs). Proven expertise in HR data quality and process improvement. Experience leading HR projects and driving automation. Advanced Workday and ServiceNow knowledge. Advanced Excel skills; Power BI experience is an advantage. Excellent communication skills in English. 

 Your Background 
 Graduate in any discipline (MBA HR preferred). Lean certification (good to have). 5-9 years of experience in HR Operations. Experience supporting North America or EMEA preferred. Flexibility to work rotational shifts. 

 Work Schedule 
 This role operates on rotational shifts across regions. Working hours will vary depending on shift schedules, requiring adaptability to support operations seamlessly across Europe and the Americas.

title: Relationship Manager - B2B
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Acquire and manage corporate, institutional, and facility-level contracts. This is a field-heavy, relationship-driven role you will be out meeting decision-makers, walking sites, and servicing accounts in person across NCR. Contract value is high and margins are thin, so accuracy in scoping and SLA discipline matter more than volume. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Corporate Acquisition & Prospecting Build and work a territory-mapped prospect list across societies, offices, hubs, and hospitals in your assigned NCR zones. Drive pipeline through cold outreach, in-person meetings, and referrals. Own the full cycle from first meeting to signed contract. 2. Site Survey & Scope Definition Visit the client site before quoting. Assess manpower requirement, task volume, coverage hours, and operational complexity. Under-scoped contracts destroy margin an accurate on-ground survey is the first line of defence. 3. Commercial Negotiation & Contracting Prepare and present proposals with correct pricing; negotiate rate cards, SLAs, payment terms, and contract duration. Coordinate with the Business Head for approval on any deal below the defined margin floor. Never sign below the approved margin threshold without escalation. 4. Documentation & Compliance Own the paperwork end-to-end proposals, work orders, agreements, MSAs, vendor registration, GST and statutory documentation, and client-side compliance formalities. B2B clients often have long vendor-onboarding processes; drive these to closure rather than waiting on the client. 5. SLA Management & Service Delivery Oversight Coordinate with the Operation Manager and Operations Executives to ensure contracted SLAs are met. Conduct periodic on-site service audits at every managed account. Document performance against SLA this record is the basis for the compliance premium we charge and for renewal negotiations. 6. Account Management & Renewals Maintain regular in-person contact with every active account; conduct quarterly business reviews. Identify expansion opportunities within the account additional sites, additional service lines. Own renewal well before expiry; a contract renewed late is a contract at risk. 7. Collections Support Track invoicing and follow up on receivables with the client. B2B payment cycles are long active follow-up is part of the role, not an afterthought. 8. Reporting & CRM Log every visit, meeting, and commitment in the CRM the same day, with visit photographs and notes where required for audit trail. Submit weekly pipeline and account-health reports to the Business Head. 
 Requirements 2 to 5 years in B2B, institutional, or corporate sales preferably facility management, staffing, logistics, or business services. Must own a two-wheeler or four-wheeler with a valid driving licence and be willing to travel daily across NCR. Thorough familiarity with NCR geography Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Greater Noida, Faridabad, and Ghaziabad. Strong documentation and proposal-writing ability; comfortable with contracts and compliance paperwork. Confident dealing with facility heads, admin heads, RWA committees, and hospital administrators. Graduate; MBA preferred but not mandatory. 
 Good to Have Existing relationships with RWAs, facility management companies, or hospital administration in NCR. Experience managing SLA-based service contracts. Understanding of GST, vendor onboarding, and tender / RFP processes. 
 Field Coverage Non-Negotiable This role requires travel and on-ground presence across the entire NCR region (Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Greater Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, and surrounding areas), including: 
 Residential societies and RWAs society management committees, facility offices, AOA/RWA bodies. Corporate offices and business parks admin heads, facility managers, HR and procurement teams. Commercial hubs and marketplaces cluster acquisition and multi-tenant contracts. Hospitals and healthcare institutions administration, patient services, documentation desks. Hotels, co-living spaces, and institutional campuses. Government and semi-government offices where documentation services apply. Any other client location within NCR as directed by the Operation Manager or Business Head. 
 Field visits are required for prospecting, site surveys, contract negotiation, service audits, escalation handling, and periodic relationship reviews. Candidates unwilling or unable to travel across NCR should not apply. 
 Salary & Perks Fixed + incentive on contract value and gross margin. Travel reimbursement as per company policy. Paid holidays as per company policy. Opportunity for growth. Supportive work environment.
